chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. By David.

verses.text: I run go di Lord for protection. How una fit talk to my soul say, “Fly go your mountain like bird!
Because look, di wicked don bend dem bows. Dem don put dem arrows for di string, so dat dem go shoot for dark at di honest for heart.
If dem destroy di foundations, wetin di righteous fit do?”
Di Lord dey im holy temple. Di Lord dey im throne for heaven. Im eyes dey see, im eyelids dey test, di pikin dem of men.
Di Lord dey test di righteous, but im soul hate di wicked and di one wey love violence.
On di wicked e go rain coals. Fire, sulfur and burning wind go be di share of dem cup.
Because di Lord dey righteous. E love righteousness. Di honest go see im face.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. On di eighth. A Psalm by David.

verses.text: Help us, Lord, because di godly man don finish. Di faithful don vanish from among di pikin dem of men.
Everybody dey lie to im neighbor. Dem dey talk with flattering lips and with double heart.
Make di Lord cut off all flattering lips and di tongue wey dey boast,
wey don talk say, “With our tongue we go win. Our lips na our own. Who be lord over us?”
“Because of di oppression of di poor and di groaning of di needy, now I go stand up,” so di Lord talk. “I go put am for safety from dem wey dey insult am.”
Di words of di Lord na pure words, like silver wey dem refine for clay furnace and clean seven times.
You go keep dem, Lord. You go protect dem from dis generation forever.
Di wicked dey waka for every side, when wetin bad dey lifted up among di sons of men.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

verses.text: How long, Lord? You go forget me forever? How long you go hide your face from me?
How long I go dey take advice for my soul, dey get sorrow for my heart every day? How long my enemy go dey lifted up over me?
Look and answer me, Lord my God. Give light to my eyes, so dat I no go sleep for death,
so dat my enemy no go talk say, “I don win am,” and so dat my enemies no go rejoice when I fall.
But I trust your faithful love. My heart dey rejoice for your salvation.
I go sing to di Lord, because e don treat me well well.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. By David.

verses.text: Di fool don talk for im heart say, “No God dey.” Dem dey corrupt. Dem don do disgusting things. Nobody dey wey dey do good.
Di Lord look down from heaven on di pikin dem of men, to see if anybody dey wey understand, wey dey look for God.
All of dem don turn aside. Dem don become corrupt together. Nobody dey wey dey do good, no, not one.
All di wrongdoers no get knowledge, dem wey dey eat my people like how dem dey eat bread and no dey call di Lord?
Dere dem dey for big fear, because God dey with di generation of di righteous.
You dey spoil di plan of di poor, but di Lord na im refuge.
Oh, make di salvation of Israel come out of Zion! When di Lord return im people from captivity, den Jacob go rejoice and Israel go dey glad.
Lord, who go stay for your sanctuary? Who go live for your holy hill?
Di one wey dey waka blameless and dey do wetin right, and dey talk truth for im heart,
wey no dey slander with im tongue, no dey do evil to im friend and no dey insult im neighbor,
wey dey despise wicked man for im eyes, but dey honor dem wey fear di Lord, wey dey keep im promise even when e hurt and no dey change,
wey no dey lend im money with interest and no dey take bribe against di innocent. Di one wey dey do dis things no go ever shake.
Keep me, God, because I don run come to you for protection.
My soul, you don talk to di Lord say, “You be my Lord. Apart from you, I no get any good thing.”
As for di holy ones wey dey di earth, dem na di excellent ones wey all my joy dey for.
Dem sorrows go plenty, dem wey dey give gifts to another god. I no go offer dem drink offerings of blood, and I no go take dem names for my lips.
Di Lord na my share and my cup. You don make my lot safe.
Di lines don fall for me for nice places. Yes, I get good inheritance.
I go bless di Lord, wey don give me advice. Yes, my heart dey teach me for di night.
I don set di Lord before me always. Because e dey my right hand, nothing go move me.
So my heart dey glad and my tongue dey rejoice. My body go stay for safety too.
Because you no go leave my soul for Sheol, and you no go let your holy one see rot.
You go show me di path of life. Full joy dey your presence. Pleasures dey your right hand forever.
Hear, Lord, my righteous plea. Give ear to my prayer, wey no dey come from lying lips.
Make my judgment come from your presence. Make your eyes look wetin fair.
You don test my heart. You don visit me for night. You don try me and find nothing. I don decide say my mouth no go disobey.
As for di deeds of men, by di word of your lips I don keep myself from di ways of violent people.
My steps don hold your paths tight. My feet no slip.
I don call you, because you go answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.
Show your wonderful faithful love, you wey dey save dem wey run come your right hand for protection from dem enemies.
Keep me like di pupil of your eye. Hide me under di shadow of your wings,
from di wicked wey dey oppress me, my deadly enemies, wey dey round me.
Dem don close dem hard hearts. With dem mouth dem dey talk proud.
Dem don surround us for our steps now. Dem set dem eyes to throw us down to di ground.
E be like lion wey dey hungry for im prey, like young lion wey dey wait for hidden places.
Stand up, Lord, face am. Throw am down. Save my soul from di wicked with your sword,
from men with your hand, Lord, from men of di world, wey dem share dey for dis life. You dey fill di belly of dem wey you love. Dem pikin dem get plenty, and dem dey keep wealth for dem children.
As for me, I go see your face for righteousness. I go dey satisfied, when I wake up, to see your form.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. By David, di servant of di Lord, wey talk di words of dis song to di Lord for di day wey di Lord save am from di hand of all im enemies and from di hand of Saul. E talk say,

verses.text: I love you, Lord, my strength.
Di Lord na my rock, my fortress and my savior. My God, my rock, wey I run go for protection, my shield, di horn of my salvation and my high tower.
I call di Lord, wey worthy to dey praised, so I go dey saved from my enemies.
Di ropes of death surround me. Di floods of wickedness frighten me.
Di ropes of Sheol dey round me. Di traps of death come on me.
For my trouble I call di Lord and cry to my God. E hear my voice from im temple. My cry before am enter im ears.
Den di earth shake and tremble. Di foundations of di mountains shake and dem move too, because e dey vex.
Smoke go up from im nose. Fire wey dey burn come out of im mouth. Coals dey burn by am.
E bow di heavens too and come down. Thick darkness dey under im feet.
E ride on cherub and fly. Yes, e fly on di wings of di wind.
E make darkness im hiding place, im tent round am, darkness of waters and thick clouds of di skies.
From di brightness before am im thick clouds pass, hailstones and coals of fire.
Di Lord thunder for di heavens too. Di Most High talk with im voice, hailstones and coals of fire.
E send out im arrows and scatter dem. Yes, big lightning bolts, and e make dem run.
Den di channels of waters show. Di foundations of di world open for your rebuke, Lord, for di blast of di breath of your nose.
E send from high and take me. E draw me out of many waters.
E save me from my strong enemy and from dem wey hate me, because dem strong pass me.
Dem come on me for di day of my disaster, but di Lord na my support.
E bring me out to wide place too. E save me because e enjoy me.
Di Lord reward me according to my righteousness. According to di cleanness of my hands, e don pay me back.
Because I don keep di ways of di Lord and I no leave my God with wickedness.
Because all im rules dey before me. I no throw im laws away from me.
I dey blameless with am too. I keep myself from my wrong.
So di Lord don pay me back according to my righteousness, according to di cleanness of my hands for im eyesight.
With di merciful, you go show yourself merciful. With di perfect man, you go show yourself perfect.
With di pure, you go show yourself pure. With di crooked, you go show yourself clever.
Because you go save di suffering people, but di proud eyes you go bring down.
Because you go light my lamp, Lord. My God go light up my darkness.
Because by you I fit run against army. By my God I fit jump over wall.
As for God, im way perfect. Di Lord word don test. E be shield to all wey run go am for protection.
Because who be God except di Lord? Who be rock except our God,
di God wey give me strength and make my way perfect?
E dey make my feet like deer feet and put me for my high places.
E dey teach my hands to fight, so dat my arms fit bend bow of bronze.
You don give me di shield of your salvation too. Your right hand dey hold me up. Your gentleness don make me great.
You don make my steps wide under me, and my feet no slip.
I go chase my enemies and catch dem. I no go turn back until dem finish.
I go strike dem through, so dat dem no go fit rise. Dem go fall under my feet.
Because you don give me strength for battle. You don make dem wey rise against me bow under me.
You don make my enemies turn dem back to me too, so dat I go cut off dem wey hate me.
Dem cry, but nobody dey to save dem, even to di Lord, but e no answer dem.
Den I beat dem small like dust before wind. I throw dem out like mud of di streets.
You don save me from di fights of di people. You don make me head of di nations. People wey I no know go serve me.
As soon as dem hear about me, dem go obey me. Di foreigners go submit to me.
Di foreigners go fade away and come out trembling from dem strongholds.
Di Lord dey live! Blessed be my rock. Make di God of my salvation dey lifted up,
even di God wey dey take revenge for me and dey put peoples under me.
E dey save me from my enemies. Yes, you dey lift me up above dem wey rise against me. You dey save me from di violent man.
So I go thank you, Lord, among di nations and sing praises to your name.
E dey give great salvation to im king and dey show faithful love to im anointed, to David and to im family forever.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

verses.text: Di heavens dey declare di glory of God. Di sky dey show im handwork.
Day after day dem dey pour out speech, and night after night dem dey show knowledge.
No speech or language dey where dem voice no dey hear.
Dem voice don go out through all di earth, dem words reach di end of di world. For dem e don set tent for di sun,
wey be like bridegroom wey dey come out of im room and dey rejoice like strong man to run im race.
Im going out na from di end of di heavens, and im turn reach di ends of am. Nothing dey hidden from im heat.
Di law of di Lord perfect, e dey restore di soul. Di testimony of di Lord dey sure, e dey make di simple wise.
Di rules of di Lord dey right, dem dey make heart rejoice. Di command of di Lord dey pure, e dey give light to di eyes.
Di fear of di Lord dey clean, e dey last forever. Di laws of di Lord dey true and dey completely righteous.
Dem dey more to desire pass gold, yes, pass plenty fine gold. Dem sweet pass honey and di drops of honeycomb.
Plus dat one, by dem dem dey warn your servant. For keeping dem big reward dey.
Who fit know im mistakes? Forgive me from hidden mistakes.
Keep your servant back from proud sins too. Make dem no rule over me. Den I go dey honest. I go dey blameless and free from big wrong.
Make di words of my mouth and di thoughts of my heart dey pleasing for your sight, Lord, my rock and my Redeemer.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

verses.text: Make di Lord answer you for di day of trouble. Make di name of di God of Jacob lift you high,
send you help from di sanctuary and give you support from Zion,
remember all your offerings and accept your burnt sacrifice. Selah.
Make e give you your heart desire and fulfill all your plans.
We go celebrate your salvation. For di name of our God we go raise our flags. Make di Lord grant all your requests.
Now I know say di Lord dey save im anointed. E go answer am from im holy heaven with di saving strength of im right hand.
Some dey trust chariots and some dey trust horses, but we dey trust di name of di Lord our God.
Dem don bow down and fall, but we dey rise up and stand strong.
Save us, Lord! Make di King answer us when we call!
